hypothesis.claim: Antecedent rainfall and soil moisture improve detection of top-5% discharge days beyond recent 3-day rainfall alone.
hypothesis.product_update: Do not apply a global wetness rule. Learn and expose wetness skill per basin.

limitations: GloFAS discharge is modelled, not a local gauge observation.
The selected river is the largest river in the model cell and may not match the exact local river.
Weather features are sampled at one point, not integrated over the upstream basin.
The simple composite score is not a trained hydrological model.
Strong Warsaw gains make the aggregate mean look better than the cross-basin consistency warrants.
